description: This file defines an interface IBlobContainerFactory for creating blob container clients in Azure Blob Storage, along with a default implementation class DefaultBlobContainerFactory that initializes and manages a default blob container based on provided storage options. The code is part of Orleans storage providers, facilitating blob storage interactions within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: DefaultBlobContainerFactory
classes.description: A default implementation of IBlobContainerFactory that manages a default blob container using specified Azure storage options.

methods.name: GetBlobContainerClient
methods.description: Returns the default BlobContainerClient instance for the associated storage container.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the blob container client, creating the container if it does not exist.
